products(product_id, name, category, unit_price)
order_items(order_item_id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price)

For each product category, what is the total revenue and the average review rating?

finalSql: SELECT products.category, SUM(order_items.unit_price * order_items.quantity) AS total_revenue, AVG(product_reviews.rating) AS average_rating FROM products JOIN order_items ON products.product_id = order_items.product_id JOIN product_reviews ON products.product_id = product_reviews.ProductId GROUP BY products.category
